claim: The mobile_app integration page is a hub only: it states the integration lets HA mobile apps integrate with HA and is enabled by default, but it contains no notification schema or action-event details, deferring to companion and developer documentation.
stance_target: Actionable-notification round-trip behaviour for mobile_app must be cited from companion docs, not this page
quoted_support: The Mobile App integration lets Home Assistant mobile apps integrate with Home Assistant. If you are planning to use a mobile application that integrates with Home Assistant, we recommend that you keep this integration enabled. If you are a mobile app developer, see the developer documentation for instructions on how to build your app on top of the mobile app integration.
